Synopsis:
    Russian Finance Minister Siluanov met U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent on the sidelines of the G20 finance leaders meeting in North Carolina. Siluanov signaled openness to developing financial ties, framing economic dialogue as a precursor to political resolution. However, Bessent reportedly made clear no economic relief or agreements with Russia are possible until the Ukraine war ends — setting a hard precondition that limits near-term progress.
